summary: Crown Reserve Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K disclosing a Second Amendment to its March 30, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Delaware-based Carvix, Inc. via wholly owned merger sub CRAC Merger Sub Inc. The amendment restates Section 9.01(b), extending the termination right to an Outside Date of the later of February 10, 2027 or the deadline under pre-domestication organizational documents. No per-share price, premium, or board recommendation is specified. The clock extension reduces near-term deal-collapse risk; watch shareholder redemptions and any further amendments.
